author: GorgyShmorgy
body: Yes you can still adorn and remove adornments after you MF it. That note about locking it from future upgrades means absolutely nothing, seriously.

author: geohyte
body:
I would imagine a heretic jewel would help you out. Applying resistance down is a big help in battle as that can me a couple hundred to thousands of extra damage. Then if you have a follower with plenty of spells/skills putting a broken bestial eye on would help out a lot. Broken offer the same follower buff as the higher rank versions with less of the downside to my understanding. Lastly if you have no other way to apply status ailments the elemental stones are good like a jewel of Aqua(freeze) or Storma (paralyze) 

Other than those things just slot adornments that boost either survivability or damage.

author: Motor_Plantain_9897
body: You can, but know it is cheaper to adorn as you upgrade rather trying to adorn all at once after Masterforging. That said, if you're high enough tier that gold isn't really a constraint, then disregard everything I just said.
